Additive star-glow annulus texture — the halo sprite is
Source src/experiments/star-field/engine/bodies/procedural/halo.ts
UX surface Boot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

_HALO_TEX_PX

Annulus halo recipe — the additive star-glow sprite is centered on the disc, so a plain radial gradient piles its brightest ring onto the photosphere and saturates the face to white. The annulus stays transparent where the ball sits (its half-width is 2/HALO_SCALE of the sprite half — identical for every star because the sprite scales with the radius) and peaks just past the limb so the glow still reads as light escaping into space. The body's own tint is baked into the texture — a SpriteMaterial's color channel doesn't multiply the map under the node pipeline.

_HALO_CUT

Annulus geometry vs HALO_SCALE (3.6): the photosphere occupies 1/3.6 ≈ 0.28 of the sprite half-extent, so the transparent cut ends just inside the limb (0.24) and the glow peaks right AT the limb (0.32) — a peak farther out leaves a dark ring gap between the ball and its glow that reads as a hollow sphere boundary.

_HALO_T1

Eased tail stops — a linear fade keeps enough alpha near the texture rim for the sprite to read as a bounded ball; stepped stops approximate the steep physical glow curve (roughly 1/r²) so the tail is essentially invisible long before the edge.

_POINT_CORE

Point-glow geometry — a galactic star at honest chart distances is an unresolvable point of light, so its halo is a filled radial glow: a white-hot core (~diffraction point) that hands off to the star's tint and dies through the same eased tail as the annulus.

_haloRings

Memoized annulus textures — one per body id (the tint is baked in).

_pointGlows

Memoized point-glow textures — one per body id.

haloFor

Generates the additive halo sprite texture for a luminous body — a tinted annulus whose transparent center keeps the photosphere crisp while the limb bleeds warm light into space.

  • @param THREE The three.js module.
  • @param def Star def (color tints the ring, id keys the cache).
  • @returns Tinted annulus texture, or undefined.

pointGlowFor

Generates the additive halo texture for a point star — a filled radial glow with a white-hot core and the body's tint in the tail. Galactic stars never resolve a photosphere at chart distances, so their whole luminous body is this sprite (no sphere mesh); the annulus would leave a hollow center with nothing inside it.

  • @param THREE The three.js module.
  • @param def Star def (color tints the tail, id keys the cache).
  • @returns Tinted point-glow texture, or undefined.
